purpose: Prevent safe-state release from silently becoming a nominal-state claim and expose a read-only capability envelope from authoritative residual ship state.

operating_mode_classification.safe_state: Retained whenever the live ship evaluation does not support release.
operating_mode_classification.degraded_operations: Required when a verified recovery release is eligible but one or more authoritative residual indicators remain.
operating_mode_classification.nominal: Allowed only when the verified recovery assessment contains no residual indicators.

governance_note: Candidate simulation policy only. It requires separate review before any CANON or real-vehicle interpretation.
